paragraphs: The SL43 is part of the current-generation R232 SL, which was launched in 2021 and marked a significant shift for the model line: the SL moved to Mercedes-AMG exclusively. The SL43 is the entry point to this new generation, using the M139 — a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder petrol hybrid turbo engine. This is a genuine departure from the V8/V12 tradition of earlier SL generations.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SL43 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the SL43 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The R232 SL43 uses the M139 engine, which is distinct from the V8 and V12 units used in earlier generations. Because the SL43 is a modern, complex hybrid system, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming parts from a V8 engine will work — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
